text: Compile each ADR into obligations through an `ObligationCompiler`.
quote: An ADR is compiled into obligations by an `ObligationCompiler` once.

text: Store compiled obligations in a `CachedCompiler` under a key derived from the ADR's content hash and `PROMPT_VERSION`, and return the cached result on later runs until either changes.
quote: `CachedCompiler` stores the result under a key derived from the ADR's content hash and `PROMPT_VERSION`, and returns the cached obligations on every later run until either changes.

text: Give the judge the compiled obligations rather than the ADR prose.
quote: The judge sees compiled obligations, not the ADR prose.

text: Do not pass raw ADR text to the judge in place of compiled obligations.
quote: The judge sees compiled obligations, not the ADR prose.

text: Bump `PROMPT_VERSION` whenever the compile prompt changes, so that every cached compile is invalidated.
quote: Changing the compile prompt requires bumping `PROMPT_VERSION`, which invalidates every cached compile.

text: Produce identical obligations for two runs on the same ADR text and prompt version.
quote: Two runs on the same ADR text and prompt version produce identical obligations.

text: Keep the cache directory safe to commit or share between CI and developers.
quote: The cache directory is safe to commit or share between CI and developers.
